decision.rationale: Transaction TXN-007963 is for 3,445.02 EUR at BRIGHTWATER DEVICES (MER-000050) on card CRD-000236. It posted on 2026-09-12. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-30, which is 48 days later and inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation, AUTH-008166, shows entry mode ECOMMERCE (card not present), 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT, no PIN verified and the fraud flag set. Under unauthorised-card-not-present, that makes the payment unauthorised, so the transaction amount would normally be credited. The card shows no earlier purchases at this merchant: the only transaction there is the disputed one, so nothing points to an existing relationship. The credit would be 3,445.02 EUR. That is more than the 3,000.00 EUR the automated process may grant under provisional-credit, so the case goes to a specialist to decide. No action is proposed.
